verdict.rationale: The Management API lets developers order terminals and accessories by API instead of through the Customer Area. That evidence sits under an 'automating terminal management' docs section, which suggests some programmatic fleet provisioning. Otherwise, terminal management is described only through the Customer Area UI, not an API. Missing for 10: API-based device registration/assignment, remote status monitoring of terminals, remote configuration updates via API, independent or hands-on corroboration.
